newsitem.title: CANADA: Eden Roc appoints new chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Eden Roc appoints new chairman, CEO.

text.p: Eden Roc Mineral Corp said on Friday it appointed Alfred Powis as chairman and Mario Caron as its president and chief executive.
The company named Harry Quint as vice-chairman.
Powis was chairman and chief executive of Noranda Inc until 1995.

Caron was most recently the chairman and chief executive of MSV Resources, a gold and copper producer. Quint is the chairman and chief executive of Marshall Minerals Corp, Eden Roc's largest shareholder.
Powis takes over as chairman from Peter Crossgrove who has stepped down as chairman and director of Eden Roc due to increasing demands from his other endeavors.
